create.name: Ethony Dawn
create.bio:
Ethony Dawn, who works simply as Ethony, is a tarot reader, author and teacher who has read cards for clients for more than two decades. Born in Canada and brought up in Australia, she now lives in Vancouver. She describes herself as a modern witch, and her approach to the cards mixes practical reading skill with spellwork and ritual. She is the headmistress of the Tarot Readers Academy, an online school she leads that runs self-paced courses in tarot, oracle and Lenormand reading, witchcraft and running a spiritual practice, with more than ten thousand students to date.

Her books with Llewellyn are Your Tarot Court, which makes the court cards easier to read by treating them as modern personalities, and Tarot Grimoire, which pairs every card with its meaning, a spread and a simple spell; a third, Become an Exceptional Tarot Reader, followed in 2025. She has also designed several tarot and oracle decks. She reads privately over Zoom, including a yearly birthday reading that combines the natal chart with a sixteen-card spread, and on her long-running YouTube channel she reviews decks and books and talks about the craft of reading. She has taught at gatherings including Omega's Masters of the Tarot.

books.title: Your Tarot Court
books.author: Ethony Dawn
books.description: A guide to the sixteen court cards, recasting them as recognisable modern personalities and offering spreads and techniques for reading them with any deck.

books.title: Tarot Grimoire
books.author: Ethony Dawn
books.description: Goes through all 78 cards with core meanings and keywords, and gives each card its own spread and a short spell, with tables of magical correspondences.

courses.title: Birthday Tarot Reading
courses.description: A one-to-one session of about an hour that looks at your birth chart and the year's transits, then lays a sixteen-card spread covering the four seasons of your coming year. Recorded, with photos of the cards.

courses.title: 30 Minute Tarot Reading with Ethony
courses.description: A recorded half-hour tarot reading over Zoom focused on a question or situation you bring.

courses.title: Tarot by the Moon 2027
courses.description: Her annual lunar tarot guide, with new spreads for each new and full moon of the year, sold through the Tarot Readers Academy.

courses.title: Money Magic Manifestation Cards Course
courses.description: A short self-paced course and bonus material to accompany her Money Magic Manifestation Cards deck.

free_resources.title: Free Tarot 101: Become A Confident Tarot Reader
free_resources.description: A free beginners' series at her Tarot Readers Academy covering the basics of reading the cards.

free_resources.title: Fool's Journey Tarot Cheat Sheet
free_resources.description: A free poster and video lesson tracing the story of the major arcana, with keywords for each card and a printer-friendly version.
